jd_text:
Senior Backend Engineer - Payments Platform, Bengaluru (Hybrid)

We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer with 3-6 years of experience to own services
across our merchant payments and settlement platform.

Must have:
- Strong hands-on experience with Node.js and TypeScript in production
- Designing and scaling RESTful APIs used by multiple internal clients
- Solid PostgreSQL: schema design, query optimization, indexing and migrations
- Redis for caching, and background job processing with a queue
- Authentication and authorization: JWT, RBAC
- Docker and CI/CD pipelines

Good to have:
- AWS (ECS, S3, SQS) or comparable cloud infrastructure
- Kafka or another distributed message broker
- Kubernetes for orchestration
- Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, distributed tracing
- Payments domain: settlements, reconciliation, webhook handling

Responsibilities:
- Design, build and own backend services end to end, including on-call rotation
- Optimize database access patterns and API latency under production load
- Implement and maintain webhook-driven integrations with external platforms
- Write tests and participate in code review
- Mentor junior engineers and contribute to architecture decisions
